Subject: FinLytics integration — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Aman / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can validate the embeddings/reranker flow you demoed: 

- Objective: host embeddings + reranker for semantic search on customer documents (ingest -> embeddings -> candidate retrieval -> rerank).
- What we covered: SDK setup, API key auth (scoped key + org-level restrictions), routing to a dedicated model family for reranking, and structured tool-calling for document metadata.
- Action items for FinLytics: share an API key scoped to a test org (or allow our test key from your IP), and provide a representative payload (1-3 sample queries + 10 doc vectors).
- Action items for Redwood: provide a short repro guide (SDK snippets, curl examples), a one-off routing config for you to test the reranker, and a quick health checklist for timeouts/batch sizes.

I'll attach the short repro steps and a sample payload we discussed. Neha, Dylan — looping you in to support any hiccups on their side. Aman — let us know if we should spin up a short dedicated sandbox capacity for the test.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. We tried the quick curl example from the repro guide against your hosted endpoint and are seeing intermittent 500s on the /v1/embeddings endpoint when we send the batched payload. Error snippet below.

"""
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {"message": "Internal server error", "code": 500}

"""

We reproduced locally with two different payload sizes (batch of 8 and batch of 32). Timing looks like requests that include vectors with length ~1536 sometimes time out and return 500.

Can your team confirm expected vector length limits and any timeout/batch size guidance? Also attaching the small api_error_snippet.log from our side.

We can also schedule a debug session today if that's helpful.

Aman

Hi Aman — thanks for the quick repro and log. Sorry you're hitting this. A few clarifying Qs so we can reproduce on our side: 

1) Can you paste the exact curl (headers + body) you used? Especially the Content-Type and Authorization header. Please redact the API key if needed.
2) Are you using our official SDK (python/js) or direct HTTP calls? Which versions?
3) The vector length you mentioned (~1536) is within range for the model we recommended, but we have seen timeouts when a single request exceeds ~64 sequences + large per-sequence token lengths in some routing/backpressure edge cases. What are the batch sizes and per-document token estimates?
4) Can you confirm region (us-west) and whether you routed to a dedicated endpoint or the shared hosted model?

Dylan — assigning to you to grab logs (request ids) for any matching 500s from the last hour for that org id (FinLytics). If you need the sample payload, it's attached.

We can spin up a quick repro harness if you prefer; otherwise a debug call today at 2pm PT works for us.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration — intermittent 500s on embeddings

Hi all — quick update and next steps: 

- Repro steps (what we tried on our side):
  1) Used the sample_payload.json Aman provided (batch size 32, vectors length 1536).
  2) Sent via curl with Authorization: Bearer <redacted> and Content-Type: application/json to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings.
  3) Observed a 500 after ~9s for one of the requests; request id in our logs: req_6Ff1a9b2. Server-side stack shows an N+1 memory spike when serializing large batched responses leading to an internal exception in the reranker-worker.

- Short-term mitigations:
  * Reduce client-side batch to 16 vectors max (we recommend 8-16 for low-latency rerank pipelines).
  * Increase request timeout to 20s while we debug backend serialization path (default 10s).
  * If you need immediate stability for production, we can route you to a dedicated pool optimized for large-vector batches - that avoids the shared reranker-worker path.

- Next steps (action owners):
  * Dylan: create a temporary route that pins FinLytics to the dedicated reranker pool and share config (ETA 2 hours).
  * Neha: follow up with a short patch to our serialization path (internal ticket INF-5278) and schedule a deploy (ETA: tomorrow morning).
  * Aman / Priya: try reduced batch sizes and the 20s timeout and confirm if 500s persist.
  * Marissa: will schedule a 2pm PT debug call if still failing.

Aman — attaching finlytics_repro_steps.txt with the exact curl + SDK snippet and the api_error_snippet.log you sent for reference. Let us know if you want the dedicated route now.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
